name: What is the return on investment (ROI) for rental property renovations?

mainEntity.name: What is the return on investment (ROI) for rental property renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ROI for rental property renovations varies significantly by project and market. Generally, cosmetic updates and minor remodels, particularly in kitchens and bathrooms, offer the highest ROI, often ranging from 70% to over 100% of the cost recouped. Major additions or luxury upgrades tend to have lower ROIs if the market doesn't support the increased rent. Strategic renovations that improve a property's appeal and functionality while staying within budget can significantly boost rental income and property value.
acceptedAnswer.description: ROI for rental renovations varies; minor cosmetic updates and kitchen/bathroom remodels typically offer the highest returns (70-100%+ recouped).
